verses.text: For the music director. Of David. To help remember. God, hurry to rescue me. LORD, come quickly to help me.
Let those who are trying to kill me be put to shame and confused. Let those who want to ruin me be turned back in disgrace.
Let those who say, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.
But let all who look for you be full of joy and gladness because of you. Let those who love your saving help always say, "God is great!"
But I am poor and needy. Come quickly to me, God. You are my helper and my rescuer. LORD, do not wait.
